verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an API client, but the evidence shows no capability for validating live responses against an API contract such as an OpenAPI schema to detect drift. Bruno documents general assertions, test suites and CLI runs in CI. Those are building blocks a user would have to hand-write into checks, not first-party contract validation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can validate live responses against the API contract to catch drift
